formula: eval ~ beauty + female + age + minority + nonenglish + lower + (1 | course_id)
notes: ROS Beauty (Gelman/Hill/Vehtari Ch 10); beauty.Rmd fits classical stan_glm(eval ~ beauty + factor(course_id)) and variants, no random term. course_id is a repeating course identifier (0 = taught once) rendered as (1 | course_id) per the #24 repeating-cluster rule. Hamermesh/Parker teaching-evaluation data. RULE GAP: the raw source ProfEvaltnsBeautyPublic.csv carries a professor id (profnumber) that gives a different grouping of the same 463 observations; excluded as a duplicate here, so that professor grouping is lost.

formula: post_test ~ treatment + pre_test + treatment:pre_test + grade + (1 | pair_id)
notes: ROS ElectricCompany (Ch 19); electric.Rmd fits classical stan_glm(post_test ~ treatment + pre_test + treatment:pre_test) on grade subsets, no random term. pair_id is the matched pair of classes (treated + control), a repeating stratum rendered (1 | pair_id) per the matched-pair convention (#23). grade (4 levels) kept as a covariate; X is a row id, supp defined only for treated classes. The row id arrives as `Unnamed: 0` from pandas (merge refusal of `X`, corrected 2026-10-08).

formula: ppvtr.36 ~ treat + bw + hispanic + black + b.marr + lths + hs + ltcoll + work.dur + prenatal + sex + first + preterm + momage + dayskidh + income + (1 | b.state)
notes: ROS Childcare (IHDP causal-inference example, Ch 18-20); childcare.Rmd fits a classical propensity/treatment-effect stan_glm of ppvtr.36 on treat plus the ps_spec covariates, with state dummies (st5..st53) as fixed effects. b.state is the multisite cluster, rendered (1 | b.state) per the #24 fixed->random rule at low. State dummies and collinear/derived columns (white, b.8state, treat0, bs.by.aa, sample) ignored.

formula: partyid7 ~ ideo7 + race + age + educ1 + gender + income + (1 | year)
notes: ROS NES (nes_linear.Rmd 'secret weapon'); fits classical stan_glm(partyid7 ~ real_ideo + race_adj + factor(age_discrete) + educ1 + female + income) separately per election year, no random term. Pooled 1952-2000, so year repeats and is rendered (1 | year) per the #24 rule at low. real_ideo/race_adj/age_discrete are constructed in the Rmd; named here by their raw analogs ideo7/race/age. partyid7 is a 7-point party-id scale (ordinal per #23). Survey weights and alternate party/vote measures ignored.

ROS Helicopters design activity (Ch 18); helicopters.Rmd fits no model. The file has 2 helicopter designs with repeated flights each (Helicopter_ID = 1, 2), so time_sec is the measured flight time and Helicopter_ID a repeating cluster, rendered (1 | Helicopter_ID) per #24 at low. width_cm/length_cm are constant within a design (group-level). RULE GAP: only 2 groups, a minimal grouping.

formula: r ~ I + v + t + f + b + (1 | sid)
notes: ROS Incentives survey-nonresponse meta-analysis (Ch 19). incentives_full.txt is the per-condition file: sid is the study id (a repeating cluster), r the response rate, I an incentive indicator, v value, t timing, f form, b burden. The book's own model (incentives.csv) is a classical regression on the differenced rates. Grouping sid rendered (1 | sid) per #24 at low; basen (sample size) and the derived difference columns ignored.
